summary: Keep an intra-document Submittal status conflict visible to the workflow state machine instead of flattening it into one apparent status.
decision_refs: Active user goal to continue improving accuracy across RFI, Submittal and email content
Existing requirement that conflicting explicit Submittal statuses remain ambiguous and human-reviewed
approval_evidence: The active user goal explicitly includes continued Submittal accuracy improvements.
known_limitations: The index reports the conflict but does not decide which status is contractually controlling.
Only explicit statuses already present in deterministic parser contexts are compared.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no model or external provider request is used.
